minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  March 9, 2021

  The Successor Agency of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
  Tuesday, March 9, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  MAYOR/CHAIRMAN PRO TEM APPOINTMENT. It was moved by Council
  Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Padilla, and seconded
  by Council Member/Successor Agency/Housing Authority Member Faulk that the City
  Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority does hereby appoint Council Member
  Morales a Mayor/Chairman Pro Tem for City Council Meeting. The motion was carried
  by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Mayor Butts.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Pro Tem/Chairman
  Pro Tem Morales called the City Council, Successor Agency, and Housing Authority into
  joint session at the hour of 2:02 p.m.

  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
  presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor Pro Tem /Successor Agency Pro Tem
  Chairman/Housing Authority Pro Tem Chairman
  Morales,  Council Members/Successor  Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  and Faulk; and
  Absent:  Mayor Butts.
  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority officials and personnel present were as
  follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency Pro
  Tem Chairman/Housing Authority Pro Tem Chairman Morales inquired if there were any
  persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority on any item on the Agendas other than the public hearing.
  Caller (Name Unknown) commented on Warrants and Bills, and Agenda Item Nos. 2, 3,
  PH-1.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Dotson, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Padilla that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated
  March 4, 2021, in the amount of $3,551,276.55 are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Faulk, and Mayor Pro Tem/Successor Agency Pro Tem
  Chairman/Housing Authority Pro Tem Chairman Morales;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Mayor Butts.
 MINUTES. It was moved by Successor Agency Member Dotson, and seconded by
Successor Agency Member Padilla that the Minutes for the Successor Agency Meetings
held on July 7, 2020, and July 14, 2020, be approved. The motion was carried by the
following roll call vote:
Ayes: Successor Agency Members Dotson, Padilla, Faulk, and Successor Agency Pro
  Tem Chairman Morales;
Noes: None; and
Absent: Chairman Butts.

There being no further business to be presented, Successor Agency Pro Tem Morales
declared the meeting adjourned in the honor of Michelle Demarco, sister of Bill
Thompson at the hour of 2:22 p.m.

Approved this 27th day of July, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary

______________________________
Eloy Morales Jr., Chairman Pro Tem
